summary: NiSource Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of senior unsecured notes due 2032, with principal amount, coupon, and pricing left blank in this subject-to-completion document. Interest is payable semi-annually beginning 2027, and the notes are redeemable at the company's option, including a special 101% Tax Credit Event redemption. Joint book-running managers are BMO, KeyBanc, Mizuho, and PNC. This is a routine investment-grade debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch final coupon, size, and use of proceeds for refinancing.
